parts.working_md:
$f(x)=-2x^{2}-5x+3$

$x=\dfrac{b}{2a}=\dfrac{(-5)}{2(-2)}=-\dfrac{5}{4}$  or  $-1\dfrac{1}{4}$

OR  $f'(x)=0$:  $-4x-5=0$,  $x=-\dfrac{5}{4}$  or  $-1\dfrac{1}{4}$

OR  $\dfrac{\dfrac{1}{2}-3}{2}=-\dfrac{2{,}5}{2}=-\dfrac{5}{4}$

$y=f\left(-\dfrac{5}{4}\right)=-2\left(-\dfrac{5}{4}\right)^{2}-5\left(-\dfrac{5}{4}\right)+3=\dfrac{49}{8}$  or  $6\dfrac{1}{8}$

Hence the turning point of $f$ is $\left(-\dfrac{5}{4};\dfrac{49}{8}\right)$  or  $(-1{,}25;6{,}13)$

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$f(x)=-2x^{2}-5x+3=-2\left(x^{2}+\dfrac{5}{2}x-\dfrac{3}{2}\right)$

$=-2\left(\left(x+\dfrac{5}{4}\right)^{2}-\dfrac{25}{16}-\dfrac{3}{2}\right)$

$=-2\left(x+\dfrac{5}{4}\right)^{2}+\dfrac{49}{8}$

Hence the turning point of $f$ is $\left(-\dfrac{5}{4};\dfrac{49}{8}\right)$

parts.notes: The official first method prints $x=b/(2a)=(-5)/(2(-2))=-5/4$. The formula should be $x=-b/(2a)$, and $(-5)/(2(-2))=+5/4$; the printed value $-5/4$ is the correct turning-point $x$-coordinate and matches the $f'(x)=0$ and intercept-midpoint methods.

parts.working_md:
$-0{,}2t^{2}+10t=0$

$t(-0{,}2t+10)=0$

$-0{,}2t+10=0$  or  $t=0$

$t=\dfrac{-10}{-0{,}2}=50$  sec

Hence the water stops flowing $50$ seconds after it started.

alternatives.label: OR
alternatives.working_md:
$-0{,}2t^{2}+10t=0$

$t^{2}-50t=0$

$t(t-50)=0$

$t=0$  or  $t=50$

Hence the water stops flowing $50$ seconds after it started.
